title: Dizzy Gillespie in Ella's band
summary: Dizzy joined Cab later; Barefield first had him in Ella's band after Chick Webb died. He says Dizzy is clever and not dizzy at all.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: When you were with Cab, Dizzy hadn't come in the band yet or --
No, when I left Cab -- see, I left Cab, as I said, around -- just about when 1935 was going to 1936.
Six, yeah, and he didn't come until
See, Dizzy didn't come into Cab's band until way later. In fact, when I took Ella's band -- Chick died and I took Ella's band over there, and Dizzy was in that band.
Oh, RIGHT. What was he like then?

That was -- oh, Dizzy's always been the same. He's always been a guy that likes to have a lot of fun. I mean, and everybody called him Dizzy, but he's not Dizzy at all. He's really a clever man, you know, a great musician, very talented. And there's nothing really dizzy about him. I guess it's just because he acts that way, you know.
